text:
carla: Scheduling enable for model catalog: spectre-4b (v2026-03-01). Target change window tonight 00:30-01:30 UTC. Plan: 1) enable model in catalog 2) set fallback ladder: spectre-4b -> spectre-3b-quant -> default-flan 3) pin client-facing routes to v2026-03-01 for 2h 4) monitor latency & error rate. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/release/notes/spectre-4b

deploybot: deploy scheduled by carla for 2026-03-01T00:30:00Z. Prechecks: slot availability OK, catalog quorum OK. Use /deploy catalog enable --model=spectre-4b --pin-ttl=2h

ben: Quick q: pin TTL should be 2h or 1h? shorter helps rollback. prefer 1h unless telemetry slower.

carla: keeping 2h because canary traffic ramp will auto-scale in waves; but we can early-unpin after 1h if metrics look stable. monitor heatmap.

alice: I'll push the eval set for regression checks before cutover. Trigger thresholds: errors >0.5% or p95 latency >1200ms => rollback. I'll post the dashboards link.

julian: oncall (sre-oncall) will watch infra; I'll set alert: catalog.rate_exceeded and model.tail-latency. I'll be on slack for the window.

sre-oncall: Alert rules added. If error spike hits, mark incident and call rollback. :thumbsup:

deploybot: prerolling canary: 5% traffic -> 20% -> 50% over 15m steps. Fallback ordering applied: spectre-4b, spectre-3b-quant, default-flan. Canary routes pinned to v2026-03-01-canary.

carla: config snippet for pinning:
```
route: customer-facing
model_pin: spectre-4b:v2026-03-01
pin_ttl: 2h
fallback_order: [spectre-4b, spectre-3b-quant, default-flan]
```

ben: LGTM. I'll be ready to flip the pin early if needed.

alice: Posting eval harness results in ~5m. Will call rollback if regressions show.

deploybot: deploy started at 2026-03-01T00:30:10Z

deploybot: canary at 5% succeeded. metrics: error_rate 0.12%, p95 840ms. advancing to 20%.

deploybot: 20% -> 50% -> rollout complete at 2026-03-01T00:52:03Z. Final status: SUCCESS. Pin TTL applied.

carla: Thanks team. I'll draft the external release blurb and add rollback notes to runbook.

alice: Running end-to-end smoke now.

ben: leaving note: if we see drift after 1h, we do targeted pin rollback to spectre-3b-quant and open a followup.

deploybot: noted. Thread closed.
